items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: I played with one of them. But the best thing I liked, Frog Legs, Easy Winner, Chrysanthemum, Ophelia Ryan.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you, which of those rags do you like that you play from the Red Bull now?
Well I tell you I like them all. I played with one of them. But the best thing I liked, Frog Legs, Easy Winner, Chrysanthemum, Ophelia Ryan. They're real musical numbers.
What numbers did they like down here in New Orleans in holding times?
